def f(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    rays, interior = set(), set()
    apexes = [j for j in range(w) if g[0][j] != 0] + [j for j in range(w) if g[h-1][j] != 0]
    for aj in apexes:
        top = (g[0][aj] != 0)
        rng = range(h) if top else range(h-1, -1, -1)
        for sign in (1, -1):
            ray = {(i, aj + sign*d) for d, i in enumerate(rng)}
            ray = {(i, j) for i, j in ray if 0 <= i < h and 0 <= j < w}
            if not ray: continue
            # require full ray within grid (length h) to count as a side
            if len(ray) < h: ray = set()
            rays |= ray
        for i in rng:
            d = i if top else h-1-i
            lo, hi = aj-d, aj+d
            for j in range(max(lo+1, 0), min(hi, w)):
                interior.add((i, j))
    # interior only where between two existing rays: keep as computed then prune later per side rules
    for (i, j) in interior: out[i][j] = 2
    for (i, j) in rays: out[i][j] = None  # placeholder, fix below
    # keep original markers that are on rays; others become 0
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for (i, j) in interior: out[i][j] = 2
    for (i, j) in rays: out[i][j] = g[i][j]
    return out
